nom: Kopari Beauty Sun Shield On-The-Glow Sheer Stick Sunscreen SPF 40

avis.titre: Smells great but too oily and sticky for me
avis.texte: I was really excited about trying this sunscreen stick. It smells incredible, exactly like a tropical getaway. Unfortunately, it is so greasy that I can't enjoy it. I don't enjoy the feeling on my skin, and my hair sticks to my face when the wind blows. It never dries down either. I do enjoy the glitter though.
I love this Sheer Stick sunscreen! It melts into your skin, its portable ( you can put it in your purse) and its shimmery! Its perfect for touch ups. Love it!
I bought this on a whim and now I'm totally hooked. It goes on so well with no greasy feel after. Perfect for on the go!
Feels great and doesn't have a strong smell. Not greasy at all!

I'm pleased with the glowy roll on stick It protected my delicate cheek bone area and face will giving me a sun light glow that just makes you feel pretty ü§© isn't that what we all want a product that's beatifying protecting compact and affordable!

I used this for the first time while at a full on sun party! The sparkle was perfect and the SPF did its thing! The glowy look was fantastic! I appreciate this product as I am more on the mature side of the age spectrum and not everything works like this! Thank you Kopari for making this magical product!!
My kids call this my "glitter stick". whenever we travel by air, I pack this in our carry on - we have it ready as soon as we land. Can't say enough about this.
it's an amazing product, great size for travel, it's gave me a glow for a long time and protect from the sunAnd I am so happy to find items clean ingredients for my daughter and my self
Soft glitter and great coverage. My teen daughter loves this! Uses it every day in the sun and has not had a sunburn yet!
I love how simple this was to bring on my vacation without worrying about a spill It was easy to apply and protected my skin while in the sun
Absolutely love the product, finally, sun protection, without burning my eyes when I applied on my face

I love how easy it glides on my face but as much as I love a shimmery face, I find the glitter particles on this stick to be too big for the face. I think it would look so much better if they added the same glittery look as the sunglaze sheer body mist. It almost feels like I was playing with glitter, got some on my face and tried taking it off (but you know how pesky glitter it). I might have used too much because my face feels extremely oily. Next time ill just do 3-4 taps and call it good instead of running it down my cheeks and forehead. It doesnt have any fragrance. I love the convenience of having SPF on the go.

avis.titre: I'm loving ALL my Kopari products!
avis.texte: I'm loving ALL my Kopari products and believe me I bought a lot! The Kopari products I was most excited about besides the roll-on sunscreen were the Setting and Sunscreen Mists. I've used those as well as the Sun Juice the most so far. I also bought all three of the Body Glow Sunscreens as well as the Face Elixir for those days when the sun was just too strong for the Mineral Sunscreen Compact or a mist. I also can't get enough of Kopari's selection of body care products, the body washes, body butters, and the hair and body mists. I especially can't get enough of Kopari's signature scent of sweet coconut milk and vanilla. I could literally drench myself in that stuff from head to toe. I'm kinda wishing I'd never bothered purchasing any Sol de Janeiro products or their dupes. Needless to say, I'm beyond thrilled with my Kopari purchase. Although I can't say the same for my husband as I probably burned a hole right through our credit card. But hey, at least I smell good...
I have this Sunscreen in my car . I use it regularly when I drive to protect my Hands . It is very easy to use and easy to apply and reapply.it's also easy to put on my neck and chest when driving!

avis.titre: Not for my oily skinned girls
avis.texte: I wanted to like this product, waited so long to try it. I have oily skin, when i put this on it made my skin look nice but to the touch slippery and oily to anything it touches like your hair or fingers. It broke me out within one use. Had a nice smell though.

avis.titre: Sun Shield On The Glow Sheer Stick Sunscreen
avis.texte: This is the second stick I have ordered. Love this product as well, as the spray. The way it feels on my face, the coverage, and the smell are unique and inviting. ‚ù£Ô∏è

I am pale, it is what it is. In my youth I would try to tan but it would end with me burnt in under 15 minutes of direct sun. I've come to terms with how fair I am and now I protect my skin as much as possible, BUT, most sunblocks don't work on my skin (of course SIGH). This little stick of gold does though! It isn't heavy or greasy and I can use it on my face, neck, ears, and body with no breakouts or irritation. The glitter isn't overwhelming either. It lasted through several hours of hot, sweaty days during Fourth of July and a trip to a Midwest theme park, leaving me as paperwhite as ever. I even used it on my sunburn prone niece and nephew during a July outdoor celebration and neither of them burned either. Konpari Beauty now has a life long fan in this porcelain skinned woman!

Love all these sheer sunscreens that are coming out now, and this one is extra fun with the glitter. It definitely starts out with a lot of shine, but settles in quickly to leave a subtle glow that is a combination of moisture and sparkle. Overall it's a winner for me.
The sparkle is really pretty but it's a little too greasy which it was more dry.

The smell of this sunscreen is nice, but it is super greasy. I had to reapply several times in a six hour day outside. My face still got sunburned on my cheeks and nose. I also woke up the following day with a rash on my neck, cheeks, and forehead. It was quite sensitive, and it burned. I'm not a fan of this product.
I really love the great healthy ingredients and the ease of application and effectiveness. It checks all of the boxes and I will buy again. Great alternative to harmful and hard to apply sunscreens,

Its okay. Doesnt provide enough protection. I still burned slightly but not too bad. Followed the directions. Wouldnt recommend for your entire body. Its good for small sections if your just running errands.
My granddaughter loves this. This is very sheer and is great to keep in your bag. Easy to reapply
I have very sensitive skin, this product works very well, product didn't cause my face to break out or burn when applied.

I used this on my collarbones and they were the first thing my husband noticed - MISSION ACCOMPLISHED. I primarily got this for the travel-friendliness, as it's solid and small, but I'll also be using this for some added sparkle as-needed. Love this so far and will buy again!

I bought this as I had a trip and didn't want to pack a drippy lotion in my carry-on. I love it, I apply it over my moisturizer to my face and neck only and it hasn't caused any breakouts. Yes it has glitter , but as someone who isn't a big make-up wearer this isn't a big deal to me. If glitter bothers you it isn't for you. I haven't used it on my body as there are cheaper options for that.
Well the package is deceiving before you buy bc the yellow label hides all of the large flecks of glitter pieces
This sunscreen is super lightweight with a little sparkle. I keep it in my purse and the stick is so easy to re-apply. My absolute new fav!
So much fun! I love adding a bit of sparkle to my face. And for a great reason... Sun protection! I love in Florida and swim daily.
Great product to have with you at all times. Nice and glowy. Great product.

I liked this because the application was smooth and clear and moisturizing. Although I couldn't stand the strong scent and the glitters were too big for my liking. I can't rate the sun protection though
This has a great lightweight and silky feel when applied and to top it off the glittery finish looks beautiful!!
It's portable and easy to carry. Easy to apply and smells amazing
I love the smell, I love that I cant take it with me anywhere. It did Irritated my face a little bit so im just using the sun shield on my body.

avis.titre: Great to have in your purse!
avis.texte: I love this! So convenient for on the go sunscreen reapplication, and feels great. Hasn't caused any breakouts, which is a huge plus, and the golden shimmer is super fun and flattering.

avis.titre: If you can look past the glitter
avis.texte: This is the best sunscreen stick I've ever used. You can use it anywhere, and even on the face it doesnt break me out. It smells nice and is so easy to toss in a bag and reapply as needed. The glitter is something I dont mind, but my bf is not a fan! If they came out with a shimmer/clear version, it would appeal to a lot of people! Overall it lasts for a long while and I will repurchase.

This is a pretty product, but the large glitter chunks are just not for me at all. If you want people to be able to see visible glitter flakes on your body, you might like this. Maybe good for a festival or something. I prefer a more pearly glow like the liquid version of this product. I would never use this on the face. It does glide on really nicely though.
It does gives the sparkles which I love, but in my opinion it's a bit more to the oily side for my face so I will use as body sunscreen and I also would rather have non scented.
This one is way more glittery than the liquid glow SPF. Not my favorite since it gets on my clothes and face. Oh well, I will stick with the other products from Kopari because they really are great.

Love this SPF stick - smells like mango, feels smooth, and gives the shimmer to my skin I want. It's great to have in your purse so you can re-apply sunscreen throughout the day to keep your skin protected. I carry it with me at all times and use it on my face, neck, and hands.
Did not provide protection. Got a sunburn despite re-applying.
Love the shimmer in this stick! Non greasy and smells great! Also fits nicely in my purse to take on the go.
I love this stick & gjves you a little glutter and smooths your skin and protects you

Great spf for travel or beach/pool days. Leaves skin dewy and sparkly and absorbs pretty well and has a nice scent… So, listen to the reviews! It does has large chunks of glitter flakes. It will be noticeable on the skin. However, I've been using this for the past few days on my face and I like it. Be careful applying to close to the eye area because it can burn… Has a nice light tropical scent.
I love this stick & gjves you a little glutter and smooths your skin and protects you
I love how easily it fits in my handbag. I recently was walking to Vegas Strip and was glad I had it on me for convenient application for the heating sun.
I love how easily it fits in my handbag. I recently was walking to Vegas Strip and was glad I had it on me for convenient application for the heating sun.

The flaw is the glitter. Please please either change the size (make it smaller) or the color (can look brown/like dirt in the right light) or ideally both

This stuff is so pretty on the skin and effective! This is part of my daily routine. I put it on mu chest / arms and its very comfortable and long lasting. I wore it out in the pool for 2+ hours (im very very fair skinned) and i did not burn. This product gives me the perfect glow. Due to the heavy oils and glitter, i would not put this on my face, but it's beautiful elsewhere.
not greasy, not too glowy, feels lightweight, overall great product! but that glitter is pretty big AND it sticks a lot - even after a shower it was still there, so just be aware if that bothers you!
The subtle glow it provides while staying sheer is great. Easy to use and makes my look beautiful.

I use this as a cute little add on after my thicker SPF creams. The glitter adds a cute glow and its perfect for reapplying throughout the day.

Sadly my years of sun have caught up with me, so I am always on the hunt for a good sunscreen that does not leave a white mask or is drying to my face. The glitter is fun too, not too much.

The stick format makes it super easy to apply and I can't wait to use this stick throughout the warmer months!

I got this as soon as it came out, I'm really excited to wear it this summer! The first application, there were some big sparkles, but once I swiped it a few more times, it applied evenly. I like the highlight and sunscreen in one of this product.

Kopari has done it again with this travel friendly, glowy SPF stick! I love the subtle shimmer it gives me and it smells incredible! Great to throw in my bag for easy on the go application. I have especially loved using this on the tops of my hands when i drive!

I love a shimmery, glowy sunscreen. But this is not it. It's totally unusable as a face stick. There are huge chunky (but also sparse) pieces of glitter in it. It's not super fine, shimmery mica. It's BIG chunky glitter - think chunky glitter nailpolish. It looks like you were in a kindergarten arts and crafts class and glitter got all over your face. Not cute. Gave it 2 stars because the formula is nice otherwise, doesn't feel sticky or heavy, and it has a nice scent - what you expect of Kopari.
This is perfect for your purse--very shimmery and easy to transport.

I was very excited for this product! The sparkles in the product are obviously visible through the container, so it wasn't a surprise that the glitter that came out was very noticeable. But, it looks like glitter glue from the craft store on skin. The pictures on the model are VERY misleading, and I don't think any of the actual product is on the model either. It is definitely not a highlighting glow, the sparkles are large, thick, sticky, and noticeable. One swipe from this stick and literal chunks of gold glitter will be stuck to your skin. If you are a glittery person and like to wear lots of glitter this is for you! But if you are wanting an illuminating glow that highlights your features, this isn't it. This would be fun for an outdoor concert or festival, but not everyday wear to put on my cheeks or collarbones. I returned after trying!

I got this as part of the travel set, hoping to use it on vacation for easy application to my arms and legs. Unfortunately, this contains very large pieces of glitter that gets everywhere. It looks like there is only a slight shimmer online, but in reality, it is straight up glitter. It's too bad, because it smells good and applies smoothly, but oh that disco glitter just is just not for me. If you are a young adult going to raves while on spring break in Miami, this is for you!
This is perfect for your purse--very shimmery and easy to transport.
So unless you are in your 20s and/or are going for the sparkle rave look this is not the right product for you. Think big noticeable pieces of glitter. Wish I could return

I haven't used it on my face bc it has glitter in it, which I don't use in my face but, given the way it feels, I think it would be lovely on your face. Another great kopari product!
